request.style: English, bright female solo voice, acoustic guitar, flute, light percussion, warm strings, hopeful and gentle mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Jehdeiah stood among the Levites
Explaining the Law to the assembly
Reading from the book of God
Making the words clear and true
The people listened in their places
Understanding the divine command
A time of renewal in Jerusalem
After the long exile was done

[Chorus]
Stand up and bless the Lord your God
From everlasting to everlasting
Blessed be your glorious name
Exalted above all praise
The covenant is sealed in faith
We follow the Lord's commands

[Verse]
Nehemiah and Ezra spoke
To the weeping crowd that day
This day is holy to the Lord
Do not mourn or weep
The joy of the Lord was our strength
As we heard the words of law
Jehdeiah led us in prayer
Lifting our hearts in praise

[Chorus]
Stand up and bless the Lord your God
From everlasting to everlasting
Blessed be your glorious name
Exalted above all praise
The covenant is sealed in faith
We follow the Lord's commands

[Verse]
We pledged to follow Moses' law
To keep the Sabbath holy
To separate from foreign ways
And love the Lord with all
Jehdeiah signed the agreement
With the priests and leaders
A community rebuilt in grace
Living under God's protection

[Chorus]
Stand up and bless the Lord your God
From everlasting to everlasting
Blessed be your glorious name
Exalted above all praise
The covenant is sealed in faith
We follow the Lord's commands
